name: Retell AI
positioning: A platform for building voice agents with a visual conversation flow builder, call analytics and a range of voice and language model options.

pricing.model: Per-minute pricing that varies with the voice, language model and telephony options you select
pricing.headline: Listed at $0.07 to $0.31 per minute depending on configuration
planNotes: The pricing page shows a worked example that adds language model, voice infrastructure and text-to-speech charges.
New accounts are shown with starting credit on the pricing page.
pricing.freeTrial: New accounts receive starting credit, according to the pricing page.

strengths.claim: Offers a visual conversation flow builder alongside prompt-based agents.
Publishes a wide list of supported languages in its documentation.

limitations.claim: The price per minute depends on configuration, so a single figure is not published.

stepsToLeave: Open each agent and copy its prompt, conversation flow and tool settings into your own notes.
Export call history and recordings for the period you need to keep.
Record which phone numbers were purchased through Retell AI.
Cancel the plan after the new agent is live.

bestFor: Teams that want a visual flow builder and a hosted platform for production voice agents.
